argv: async () => {const v=document.querySelector("video");if(!v)throw Error("no video");if(v.readyState<2)await new Promise((ok,no)=>{v.addEventListener("loadeddata",ok,{once:true});setTimeout(()=>no(Error("load timeout")),10000)});v.muted=true;await v.play();const start=v.currentTime;await new Promise(ok=>setTimeout(ok,600));v.pause();if(v.error||v.videoWidth!==160||v.videoHeight!==90||v.currentTime<=start||v.duration!==4)throw Error("video not playing");return {src:v.currentSrc,width:v.videoWidth,height:v.videoHeight,duration:v.duration,start,end:v.currentTime,readyState:v.readyState,error:v.error}}
